info.title: Bambora / Worldline North America Payment API
info.description: North American payment processing API by Bambora (now Worldline). Supports card payments, tokenization, payment profiles, returns, voids, completions, recurring billing, and reporting. Used for direct payment gateway integration.

post.description: Processes a payment transaction. Supports card, token, payment profile, cash, cheque, Apple Pay, Google Pay, 3D Secure token, and processor token payment methods.

get.description: Retrieves the details of a previously processed payment transaction by its transaction ID.

post.description: Processes a return (refund) against a previous payment transaction. Supports full or partial returns.

parameters.name: transId
parameters.description: Original transaction identifier to return against

post.description: Voids a previously authorized payment transaction before it has been settled.
Captures a previously authorized (pre-auth) payment. Completes the transaction so funds are transferred.

parameters.name: transId
parameters.description: Transaction identifier of the pre-auth to complete

post.description: Continues a payment flow after 3D Secure authentication or other redirect-based verification steps.

parameters.name: merchant_data
parameters.description: Merchant data token from the initial payment response

post.description: Creates a new payment profile to securely store customer card information for future transactions.

get.description: Retrieves a payment profile with stored customer and card information.

put.description: Updates an existing payment profile's customer or billing information.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a payment profile and all associated card data.

get.description: Retrieves all cards stored on a payment profile.

post.description: Adds a new card to an existing payment profile.

get.description: Retrieves details of a specific card on a payment profile.

put.description: Updates card information on an existing payment profile.

delete.description: Removes a card from a payment profile.

post.description: Searches for transactions using various filter criteria including date range, amount, card type, and status.

get.description: Retrieves the card settlement report for a specified date range.
Retrieves the merchant statement report for a specified month range.

post.description: Creates a single-use payment token from card details. The token can then be used for a payment request without transmitting card data to the merchant server.

get.description: Retrieves details of a recurring billing account including schedule, status, and payment history.

SubMerchantId.name: Sub-Merchant-Id
SubMerchantId.description: Optional sub-merchant identifier for payment facilitator integrations

complete.description: True for purchase, false for pre-auth
True for purchase, false for pre-authorization

type.description: Transaction type (P=Purchase, PA=Pre-Auth, PAC=Pre-Auth Completion, R=Return, VP=Void Purchase, VR=Void Return)
